text: Captain, we've got into trouble!\nThe advance troop has been surrounded by enemies!!
Yea, he shouldn't have charged into there without\nthinking!
We've gotta go! We must help them on the way!!
You can't go without weapons, take this.
Isn't it yours?\nYou become unarmed if you give this to me...
Nooo problem! That's a spare.\nMine is here!
Where did you put such a big weapon...?
Now, let's go! Follow me, big sis!!
You owe your life to them.\nThey saved you without blaming your attitude.
I... I haven't accepted you yet!!
Heh heh heh! Lepage seems embarrassed!!
Is that so? Then, he has great trouble in\nexpressing feelings...
The time is running out.\nThe enemies could be increasing...\nHurry!
